biotools.summary: The Xeva package provides efficient and powerful functions for patient-drived xenograft (PDX) based pharmacogenomic data analysis. This package contains a set of functions to perform analysis of patient-derived xenograft data. This package was developed by the BHKLab, for further information please see our documentation.
